user.title: Connect to Honeycomb
user.description: Use an ingest key from the Honeycomb environment the home's telemetry should go to.

data_description.api_key: Honeycomb › Environment settings › API keys. An ingest key is enough.
data_description.region: Where your Honeycomb team keeps its data.
data_description.service_name: The dataset the home's traces arrive in.

error.invalid_auth: Honeycomb did not accept this API key.

abort.already_configured: This Honeycomb environment is already connected.

init.title: What to send
init.description: Everything in the home is sent, except where people are, readings from bodies, phones' sensors and cameras. Leave out more here, or send some of those anyway.

data_description.exclude: Entity ids; `*` stands for any text: `sensor.*_power` leaves out every power sensor, `sensor.*` every sensor.
data_description.exclude_areas: Every entity in these areas, or on a device in them.
data_description.include: Entity ids or patterns of what is left out by default, such as `device_tracker.example_phone`. What you leave out above stays out.
data_description.attributes: Attribute names, such as `brightness`. Each is sent as `ha.attr.` and its name, for every entity that has it.
